The upgrade is feasible, but it needs one dependency pin and four small code changes. The four code changes also work on 6.5.12, so they can ship first. The most serious problem is one the existing tests can't see. If you only change the sidekiq version in the Gemfile, Bundler also upgrades connection_pool from 2.5.5 to 3.0.2. The working checkout at `/home/user/workspace/repo` was not modified; `git status` was clean at the end. All experiments ran in disposable clones under `/tmp/sidekiq-exp/`.
